payload.name: Curiosity as a predictor of web panel survey participation
payload.fact: Curiosity is a significant predictor of joining web panels and participating in surveys, and it also affects the effort participants put into their responses.

provenance.title: Determinants of Participation and Response Effort in Web Panel Surveys
provenance.quote_or_locus: Results revealed that consumers’ need for cognition, curiosity, agreeableness and extraversion were significant predictors of joining the web panel. The first three traits also predicted survey participation, as did openness to experience. Among participants, response effort was affected the greatest by curiosity, extraversion, and conscientiousness
